usedFor: ERP Docs prepares and signs agreements, and “Create Document from Template” drafts one without sending it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Document from Template” in ERP Docs
bestTemplate.why: The action drafts the agreement from a template as an unsent draft, ready for you to review.

watchOut: “Send Document Reminder” emails recipients outside your business, so it waits for your approval.
